title: Skills vs Tools: When to use what?

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video about when to use skills and when to use tools in Microsoft 18 Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支 C# AI 影片要介紹：在 Microsoft Agent Framework 中，何時用技能，何時用工具。

cues.en: And the reason for this video is because of a recent video I made that defined these terms on how they work.
cues.zh: 原因是我最近製作了一支影片，解釋這些術語與運作方式。

cues.en: And I mentioned behind the scenes, these are actually more or less the same.
cues.zh: 我提到，背後其實大致使用相同機制。

cues.en: And I'm loosely putting MCPs into tools as well, because that's essentially what they are.
cues.zh: 也把 MCP 大致歸在工具這邊，因為它們本質上就是工具。

cues.en: It's just a different way of defining them.
cues.zh: 只是定義工具的方式不同。

cues.en: But in most cases, I mentioned loosely in that video that tools are the best thing to do.
cues.zh: 在那支影片中，我大致提到，多數情況下使用工具最合適。

cues.en: And many people still don't think that.
cues.zh: 但很多人仍然不同意。

cues.en: They claim that skills are better and cheaper than tools and MCPs.
cues.zh: 他們認為技能比工具與 MCP 更好，也更便宜。

cues.en: So I wanted to actually go in and explain this in a little more detail by actually measuring it.
cues.zh: 所以想透過實際測量，進一步解釋。

cues.en: I want to give AI three capabilities about weather, both as skills and as tools, and then actually let us look at how many input tokens it use.
cues.zh: 我會提供三項天氣相關能力，分別以技能與工具實作，再觀察使用多少輸入 Token。

cues.en: Because it will be the same amount of output tokens based on the AI, of course.
cues.zh: 輸出 Token 當然主要取決於 AI 回應內容，兩者大致相同。

cues.en: And if it's a big tool with a lot of data inside it, doesn't really matter because they still need to read them both.
cues.zh: 即使工具回傳大量資料，也沒有差別，因為兩種方式都需要讀取相同內容。

cues.en: So it is the way we give it to the AI that have the impact on how much it actually costs.
cues.zh: 因此影響成本的是，我們如何把能力提供給 AI。

cues.en: Nothing about quality and the size of the tool, at least in terms of if it's giving us back an entire book or just giving us back a hello.
cues.zh: 這裡不是比較品質，也不是工具回傳整本書或只回傳你好這種輸出大小差異。

cues.en: That will be the same for both of them.
cues.zh: 那些對兩者都相同。

cues.en: But let's have a look at first the skills implementation.
cues.zh: 先看看技能的實作。

cues.en: So in this case, I'm using agent inline skills from the agent framework team.
cues.zh: 這個例子使用 Agent Framework 團隊提供的 AgentInlineSkill。

cues.en: I could also use my own skills implementation or we could have made it ourself.
cues.zh: 也可以用我的技能實作，或自己實作。

cues.en: But in our case, we're just making a weather skills tool skill here.
cues.zh: 這裡建立一個天氣技能。

cues.en: And we just say it's for weather-related stuff.
cues.zh: 描述只說明用於天氣相關功能。

cues.en: And instructions inside the skill will be that we have a get weather for city to get the weather.
cues.zh: 技能內的指示會說，有 GetWeatherForCity 可以取得天氣。

cues.en: We have a resource called how to predict weather that tells how it's predicted and who's in charge of the weather.
cues.zh: 另外有 HowToPredictWeather 資源，說明如何預測天氣，以及誰負責天氣。

cues.en: So we add the skill, so the script, and the script is just a normal delegate.
cues.zh: 接著加入技能指令碼，這裡只是一般委派。

cues.en: Had it been a folder and file-based skill, it would probably have been a Python script, for example.
cues.zh: 如果技能存放在資料夾與檔案中，可能就會是一支 Python 指令碼。

cues.en: But in our case, we just make it so we can mimic as much of a tool as possible.
cues.zh: 但這裡希望盡可能模擬一般工具，因此直接這樣實作。

cues.en: We then add two resources, how to predict the weather, where we say we just need to look outside the window and check if it's rainy or sunny.
cues.zh: 再加入兩個資源。如何預測天氣的答案，就是往窗外看，是下雨還是晴天。

cues.en: And we make a resource that is who's in charge of the weather.
cues.zh: 另一個資源則回答誰負責天氣。

cues.en: That's some old guy in an old sweater.
cues.zh: 答案是某位穿著舊毛衣的老人。

cues.en: Nothing too important here. I'm just making some tools.
cues.zh: 內容不重要，只是在建立範例工具。

cues.en: And again, doesn't matter if we had a one-liner here or 10,000 lines of text.
cues.zh: 再次強調，不論這裡只有一行，還是一萬行文字，

cues.en: A tool and a skill would have given that to the AI in exactly the same way, and that would just have been the same amount of tokens.
cues.zh: 工具與技能最後都會以相同方式把內容提供給 AI，因此資料本身的 Token 用量相同。

cues.en: But I have my skill, and I turn that into an agent skill provider, disabling the auto-approval, so we don't spend any time on that.
cues.zh: 取得技能後，轉成 AgentSkillsProvider，並關閉自動核准要求，避免這部分干擾。

cues.en: And then I'm giving it to the agent.
cues.zh: 接著提供給代理程式。

cues.en: And the agent gets it as AI context provider.
cues.zh: 代理程式透過 AI Context Provider 接收它。

cues.en: And I'm just showing the raw HTTP call and the raw tool code so we can see what actually happens.
cues.zh: 這裡也顯示原始 HTTP 呼叫與工具呼叫，方便看清楚過程。

cues.en: Because when we call this agent, for example, how to get the weather, it will, of course, need to do something more than just immediately know
cues.zh: 因為呼叫代理程式，例如詢問如何取得天氣時，它當然不可能立刻，

cues.en: because the skill is just there, and we need to still invoke that we want to actually use that skill,
cues.zh: 知道答案。技能雖然存在，仍然需要實際要求使用技能，

cues.en: read up on what's in there, call it script, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 讀取內容、呼叫指令碼等等。

cues.en: So when we have this and actually see what happens when we invoke the agent, we will see that despite me not adding any instructions
cues.zh: 因此觀察呼叫代理程式的實際過程，可以看到即使我沒有提供，

cues.en: to the previous window, we will get these instructions.
cues.zh: 前面那些指示，系統仍會產生這些內容。

cues.en: And this is how the agent framework presents instructions.
cues.zh: 這就是 Agent Framework 呈現指示的方式。

cues.en: A little bit both, in my opinion.
cues.zh: 在我看來有點冗長。

cues.en: We could have done this less with both, but I'm taking it out of the box, which most of you will probably also do.
cues.zh: 其實可以寫得簡短一些，但這裡採用預設行為，多數人應該也是如此。

cues.en: But there is ways of actually reducing this a bit.
cues.zh: 確實有方法可以減少這些內容。

cues.en: But essentially, we're just saying we have these skills.
cues.zh: 不過本質上，就是告訴模型有哪些技能。

cues.en: And in order to load those skills, we have a load skill tool, a read skill resource, and a run skill script
cues.zh: 為了載入技能，還會提供 LoadSkill、ReadSkillResource，以及 RunSkillScript，

cues.en: because that's the thing that most people get wrong.
cues.zh: 這正是很多人誤解的地方。

cues.en: Just because it's a skill, we still need some tools to actually read that skill.
cues.zh: 即使叫技能，仍然需要工具來讀取技能內容。

cues.en: And those skills come out of the box.
cues.zh: 這些工具是內建提供的。

cues.en: We didn't define any skills here, but they come with us putting in the skills provider.
cues.zh: 我們沒有另外定義它們，只要加入 Skills Provider，就會一起出現。

cues.en: So there will be a tool to load the skill.
cues.zh: 因此有載入技能的工具，

cues.en: There will be a tool to read the skill resource.
cues.zh: 讀取技能資源的工具，

cues.en: And there will be a tool to run the script.
cues.zh: 以及執行指令碼的工具。

cues.en: In the now case, that will all be in memory.
cues.zh: 這個例子全部在記憶體中處理。

cues.en: Had it been file-based, the load skill would have gone down to your hard drive and read a file.
cues.zh: 如果是檔案型技能，LoadSkill 就會到硬碟讀取檔案。

cues.en: It would have read some subfile, and it would have read and executed a script in that file.
cues.zh: 接著讀取附屬檔案，再讀取並執行其中的指令碼。

cues.en: So no matter if we do it one of the other ways, it will just happen that way.
cues.zh: 因此無論使用哪種方式，都會經過類似流程。

cues.en: And then I ask it three questions.
cues.zh: 接著提出三個問題。

cues.en: I just say, hi, in that I just want to see what happens if there's a skill available, but we don't need to use it.
cues.zh: 首先只說「你好」，觀察有技能可用、但不需要使用時的成本。

cues.en: Then I ask it, how do we predict the weather?
cues.zh: 接著問：如何預測天氣？

cues.en: And finally, what is the weather for Paris?
cues.zh: 最後問：巴黎的天氣如何？

cues.en: And when I do that, we get these results.
cues.zh: 得到的結果如下。

cues.en: So if I just say, hi, I get a response back, and we use 310 tokens.
cues.zh: 只說你好，取得回應後，使用了 310 個 Token。

cues.en: If I say, hi, how is the weather predicted?
cues.zh: 如果問「如何預測天氣？」。

cues.en: We end up using the tool load skill in order to read the skill.
cues.zh: 會先透過 LoadSkill 工具讀取技能。

cues.en: So that was essentially reading this part.
cues.zh: 也就是讀取這部分。

cues.en: And then we use read skill resource in order to read that specific resource that was how to predict the weather.
cues.zh: 接著透過 ReadSkillResource，讀取如何預測天氣的特定資源。

cues.en: And once we've done that, we have the context we need, and the AI can respond back to us that the weather can be predicted by looking outside,
cues.zh: 完成後就有必要上下文，AI 能回答：往窗外看，

cues.en: whether it's raining or sunny.
cues.zh: 看看是下雨還是晴天。

cues.en: And that uses for 1,471 tokens in my case.
cues.zh: 這個例子使用了 1,471 個 Token。

cues.en: And finally, we ask, what is the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 最後問巴黎天氣如何。

cues.en: It will again load the skill, and it will then run the script, which in our case, it was sunny and 90 degrees no matter what.
cues.zh: 同樣先載入技能，再執行指令碼。這裡無論如何都回傳晴天、90 度。

cues.en: And that's what we see here.
cues.zh: 這就是畫面上的結果。

cues.en: So this is essentially what we're sending to the LLM together with this.
cues.zh: 因此這些就是提供給 LLM 的內容，此外當然，

cues.en: It will, of course, also send my messages.
cues.zh: 也會傳送我的訊息。

cues.en: But this is the metadata that is needed in order to do the skill and use the skill.
cues.zh: 但這些是為了提供與使用技能，所需要的中繼資料。

cues.en: And that is what we're essentially paying tokens for.
cues.zh: 我們本質上是在為這些內容支付 Token 成本。

cues.en: And that is what the claim says is cheaper and faster.
cues.zh: 而大家聲稱這種方式更便宜、更快。

cues.en: So remember, 310, 1,471, and 1,472.
I have them in a separate slide later on.
cues.zh: 稍後會另外整理成投影片。

cues.en: If we do the exact same thing using tools, let's say we don't know what skills are, and we just want to do this, we again need to do one action and two pieces of information.
cues.zh: 如果完全相同的功能改用工具，假設不知道技能是什麼，我們同樣需要一個動作與兩份資訊。

cues.en: And we can do it in a slightly easier way in that we just need to make normal tools.
cues.zh: 而且寫法稍微容易一些，只需要建立一般工具。

cues.en: So the first tool was get weather for city.
cues.zh: 第一個是 GetWeatherForCity。

cues.en: That's exactly the same code.
cues.zh: 程式碼完全相同。

cues.en: How to predict the weather cannot be a resource anymore.
cues.zh: 如何預測天氣，現在不再定義成資源。

cues.en: But we need to make a tool that can give back the same information and who's in charge, which is not called at any point.
cues.zh: 而是建立工具，回傳同樣的資訊。誰負責天氣也是工具，雖然測試中不會呼叫。

cues.en: But we still need to put it in there in order to have it.
cues.zh: 但為了功能對等，仍然需要提供。

cues.en: So we're essentially just instead of the skill provider, giving the tools and making up three tools here with the same name and roughly the same description.
cues.zh: 因此不再提供 Skills Provider，而是建立三個同名、描述大致相同的工具。

cues.en: And this definitely seems easier to write than the previous one, but that shouldn't really matter
cues.zh: 這明顯比前面更容易撰寫，但如果技能能提供更好的資訊，

cues.en: if we actually get better information or use less tokens.
cues.zh: 或更少 Token，程式碼差異就不重要。

cues.en: But what you will see is that the tools we sent is these tools instead.
cues.zh: 不過現在送出的工具定義是這些。

cues.en: They roughly look the same as the other tools that we saw in skills.
cues.zh: 外觀和技能版本產生的工具大致相同。

cues.en: So we're essentially sending three tools here, which was just to load and read skills.
cues.zh: 技能版本也是送三個工具，只是用來載入與讀取技能。

cues.en: Over here, it is to actually get the weather for city, how to predict weather and who's in charge of weather.
cues.zh: 這裡則直接取得城市天氣、預測方法，以及天氣負責人。

cues.en: So we're just sending them as tools instead of tools that can read skills.
cues.zh: 因此直接提供功能工具，而不是讀取技能的工具。

cues.en: And what we end up is that if we just say hi, we use 85 tokens.
cues.zh: 結果是，只說你好時，使用 85 個 Token。

cues.en: If we want to know how the weather is predicted, we end up using 229.
cues.zh: 詢問如何預測天氣，使用 229 個。

cues.en: And if we want to know the weather for Paris, calling a tool, we get 223.
cues.zh: 呼叫工具查詢巴黎天氣，使用 223 個。

cues.en: So here's the summary between the two.
cues.zh: 這裡就是兩者的比較。

cues.en: And we can see that in this specific case, we have roughly three times as many tokens here. What's that?
cues.zh: 可以看到，在這個特定情況中，技能的 Token 大約是三倍，還有，

cues.en: Five times, six times more, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 五倍、六倍等等。

cues.en: So those who claimed this certainly was wrong in this scenario.
cues.zh: 因此認為技能一定比較省的說法，在這個情境下確實不對。

cues.en: So what's up with all this?
cues.zh: 那究竟是怎麼回事？

cues.en: And why can we see that skills are actually more expensive than tools?
cues.zh: 為什麼技能實際上比工具更貴？

cues.en: Despite everyone saying skills help being much more cheap and simple to use.
cues.zh: 明明大家都說技能比較便宜，也更容易使用。

cues.en: And that is a matter of how many.
cues.zh: 關鍵在於數量。

cues.en: Because what I'm doing here, I'm going in and manipulating the code a bit and now simulating it that I have more skills and more tools.
cues.zh: 接著稍微修改程式，模擬更多技能與更多工具。

cues.en: Because before we only had three tools to read skills,
cues.zh: 先前技能版本只有三個工具，用來讀取技能，

cues.en: to read skills, read resources and execute script.
cues.zh: 讀取資源與執行指令碼。

cues.en: And in my case, we had three tools when we just did the tool version.
cues.zh: 而直接使用工具的版本，也剛好只有三個工具。

cues.en: But now I'm just putting them in a for loop and pretending that I needed multiple weather skills and I needed multiple get weather for city skills.
cues.zh: 現在把它放進 for 迴圈，假裝需要多個天氣技能，以及多個 GetWeatherForCity 工具。

cues.en: In real life, you of course have tools to do different things.
cues.zh: 實際情況中，當然會是執行不同功能的工具。

cues.en: But just to keep it easy here, I'm just giving the same tool 10 times in a row.
cues.zh: 不過為了簡化，這裡連續加入十次相同功能。

cues.en: Meaning that I end up with 10 different skills that can do 30 different capabilities
cues.zh: 最後會有十個技能，總共提供三十項能力，

cues.en: and 30 tools in order to see difference.
cues.zh: 以及三十個工具，用來比較差異。

cues.en: Because it's all about how much of this metadata we have, how much of this do we have both from skill side and from tool side.
cues.zh: 因為重點是這些中繼資料的多寡，技能與工具各有多少。

cues.en: And that's where it begins to become interesting.
cues.zh: 這時比較就開始有意思了。

cues.en: Because we saw it with one skill and three capabilities, we ended up with these numbers here,
cues.zh: 前面一個技能、三項能力時，得到的是這些數字，

cues.en: where this was three to five times higher.
cues.zh: 技能版本大約高三到五倍。

cues.en: But if we go to 10 skills, meaning 30 capabilities and 30 tools, it begins to shift the other way around.
cues.zh: 但增加到十個技能，也就是三十項能力與三十個工具，情況開始反轉。

cues.en: Not 100% to the favor of skills, but we can see that when we need nothing of it, it actually becomes cheaper to do skills.
cues.zh: 還不是所有情況都對技能有利，但可以看到，完全不使用功能時，技能反而比較省。

cues.en: And this is because when we increase skills over here, we are only increasing the instructions we give.
cues.zh: 因為增加技能時，只增加提供的指示內容。

cues.en: We're telling about, hey, we have this skill, we have this skill, we have this skills, meaning we have 10 different skills here.
cues.zh: 也就是告訴模型，有這個技能、那個技能，現在共有十個技能。

cues.en: But we're not increasing the amount of tools we need.
cues.zh: 但不需要增加工具數量。

cues.en: We still only need three tools to… It doesn't matter if we have one skill or 100 skills, we still just need one tool to actually read that skill.
cues.zh: 無論一個或一百個技能，仍然只需要這三個工具，其中一個負責讀取技能。

cues.en: We only need one tool to execute the scripts in those skills.
cues.zh: 也只需要一個工具執行所有技能中的指令碼。

cues.en: So whenever we end up not using any of it, because the user just said, hi, when we are up to 10 skills, meaning 30 different tools,
cues.zh: 所以使用者只說你好、完全不使用功能時，當增加到十個技能，也就是三十個，

cues.en: 30 capabilities, the question, hi, becomes more cheap.
cues.zh: 能力，這句你好就變得比較便宜。

cues.en: The question about looking up a resource is still a bit more expensive.
cues.zh: 查詢資源的問題仍然稍微比較貴。

cues.en: And we end up not using any of it because the user just said, hi, and actually calling the how to get weather
cues.zh: 和只說你好、不使用功能的情況不同，實際呼叫取得天氣，

cues.en: is also still slightly more expensive.
cues.zh: 也仍然稍微比較貴。

cues.en: This can definitely, at 10 skills, be helped a bit if we were to go in and optimize the instructions.
cues.zh: 在十個技能時，如果最佳化指示，確實還能改善。

cues.en: Again, I mentioned that 18 Framework is a bit verbose in how they present those instructions.
cues.zh: 如前面所說，Agent Framework 呈現這些指示時有點冗長。

cues.en: But we are roughly getting even around 30 tools.
cues.zh: 不過大約三十個工具附近，成本就開始接近。

cues.en: And if we go even higher to 100 skills, meaning 300 capabilities and 300 tools,
cues.zh: 如果繼續提高到一百個技能，也就是三百項能力與三百個工具，

cues.en: we can now see that high is even better over here.
cues.zh: 可以看到，技能版本只說你好更便宜。

cues.en: And again, if we load up 100 skills but use none of them, we end up using 3,680 input tokens because we still need to do the metadata.
cues.zh: 同樣地，載入一百個技能但完全不用，仍然需要 3,680 個輸入 Token，因為還是要提供中繼資料。

cues.en: But the metadata, again, we still only have three tools over here, despite having 300 over here, and then a bunch of metadata instructions.
cues.zh: 但技能端仍然只有三個工具，另一邊則有三百個工具。技能端另外再加上技能描述指示。

cues.en: But this begins to actually be better in all scenarios.
cues.zh: 此時技能在各種情境中都開始比較有利。

cues.en: So we roughly need, as you can see here, 300 tools before we break even and skills are better.
cues.zh: 所以在這個範例中，大約要到三百個工具，才能明確達到損益平衡，並讓技能勝出。

cues.en: Can we perhaps optimize the instructions I've mentioned?
cues.zh: 能不能像前面提到的，最佳化指示？

cues.en: Yes, we certainly can.
cues.zh: 當然可以。

cues.en: And then it perhaps begins to break even around 30, 40, 50, all depending on how much, because the more we break off the instructions,
cues.zh: 這樣也許在三十、四十、五十個能力時就會接近平衡，但要看刪減多少指示。刪得越多，

cues.en: the higher chance that it misunderstands what the different skills are.
cues.zh: 模型誤解技能用途的機會也越高。

cues.en: So as you can see here, if every tool was the same, you would actually go in and look at your code saying, okay, I have less than 30 tools.
cues.zh: 所以假設工具複雜度相同，可以先看看程式：目前少於三十個工具，

cues.en: I should have 30 capabilities is probably the best way of saying it.
cues.zh: 更準確地說，應該是三十項能力。

cues.en: So it's best for me to do tools.
cues.zh: 那麼使用工具比較合適。

cues.en: Second, if I go above 30, I should switch to skills.
cues.zh: 超過三十項之後，再考慮技能。

cues.en: And I don't know about you, but by me, I don't think I have ever, beyond this dummy sample here, had an agent that I gave 30 tools
cues.zh: 不知道你的情況如何，但除了這個模擬範例，我幾乎從沒提供過三十個工具給同一個代理程式，

cues.en: because I want to make my agents more deliberate.
cues.zh: 因為我希望代理程式的職責更明確。

cues.en: And that is also one of the reasons why skills are so popular in the various cloud codes, cowork, and codecs,
cues.zh: 這也是技能在 Claude Code、Cowork 與 Codex 等產品中很受歡迎的原因，

cues.en: because there you are giving a lot of different capabilities.
cues.zh: 因為那些環境會提供大量不同能力。

cues.en: I use mine for both YouTube videos and coding and all kinds of things.
cues.zh: 像我自己會用來處理 YouTube 影片、程式開發與各種工作。

cues.en: And they need those three tools to read skills anyway.
cues.zh: 而且本來就需要那三個讀取技能的工具。

cues.en: So there's no overhead in having the skills.
cues.zh: 因此新增技能不會再增加那部分固定成本。

cues.en: It just works there.
cues.zh: 在那種環境就很適合。

cues.en: But if you're in curated C-sharp code, and you're using an agent, it's often something that only have one or two purposes.
cues.zh: 但如果是在精心設計的 C# 程式中，代理程式通常只有一、兩個用途。

cues.en: Yes, you can build a chatbot, but even a chatbot, you will probably never have 30 tools.
cues.zh: 就算建立聊天機器人，也可能不會提供三十個工具。

cues.en: And as you can see, you might even need to get up to 300 tools before it makes sense.
cues.zh: 而且如前面所見，有時甚至需要三百個工具，技能才比較合理。

cues.en: There is one caveat at this, and this was that these tools I had here was fairly easy,
cues.zh: 不過這裡有一個前提：我使用的工具都很簡單，

cues.en: in that they only had an output of a string and an input of a string.
cues.zh: 輸入與輸出都只有字串。

cues.en: The input was a city name, and the output was just a piece of text that it was sunny and 19 degrees.
cues.zh: 輸入是城市名稱，輸出只是一段文字，表示晴天、19 度。

cues.en: Not all tools are created equal.
cues.zh: 並不是所有工具都一樣。

cues.en: So that's also something you need to take in mind, is how complex are your tools?
cues.zh: 因此還必須考慮，工具究竟有多複雜。

cues.en: And one example of that and a set of tools
cues.zh: 其中一組工具的例子，

cues.en: that are very badly written or not should be tools is example, the GitHub MCP.
cues.zh: 可能寫得太龐大，或不適合全部當成工具公開，就是 GitHub MCP。

cues.en: So inside the GitHub MCP, and now I'm using MCP, but again, it could just have been tools that I had written that are much more complex.
cues.zh: 現在雖然用 MCP 示範，但也可以是自己撰寫、更複雜的工具。

cues.en: Because inside the MCP here, we have 49 tools.
cues.zh: GitHub MCP 裡有 49 個工具。

cues.en: And we have just seen that, oh, we should use skills and that because we are over 30 tools because they use just one thing, high 700 T tokens.
cues.zh: 剛剛看到，超過三十個工具後，可以考慮技能，因為簡單工具僅說你好就要大約七百個 Token。

cues.en: But these tools are much, much more advanced in that we have 49 of them.
cues.zh: 但這 49 個工具複雜許多。

cues.en: That's okay, we could just take the first 30 in order to do the comparison.
cues.zh: 數量本身不是問題，也可以只取前面三十個比較。

cues.en: But as you can see, they have longer names, they have longer text, and they have much more advanced inputs and outputs.
cues.zh: 但可以看到，名稱更長、描述更長，輸入與輸出也複雜許多。

cues.en: So if we, for example, look at the first tool here, this is that one tool.
cues.zh: 例如看第一個工具，這一整段就是單一工具。

cues.en: It has a name, so it has a slightly longer description than me.
cues.zh: 它有名稱，描述也比我的版本長一些。

cues.en: But then we can see there's a bunch of parameters in, owner, repo, pool number, path, body, subject type,
cues.zh: 接著有一大堆輸入參數：owner、repo、pull_number、path、body、subject_type，

cues.en: and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 以及其他欄位。

cues.en: So this tool is roughly twice as big as my three tools, just that one out of the four.
cues.zh: 單單這一個工具，定義大小就大約是我三個工具合計的兩倍。

cues.en: And for that reason, when we say just hi to this without using any of the tools, because we need this much metadata,
cues.zh: 因此，只說你好而不使用任何工具，因為仍要傳送這麼多中繼資料，

cues.en: we actually end up spending 9,000 tokens because this is a lot of tools that are very, very complex.
cues.zh: 最後就花了九千多個 Token，因為工具既多又複雜。

cues.en: Had they been very, very simple, it would have cost a few hundred tokens, but because they are very, very complex, we would have spent a lot of money.
cues.zh: 如果工具很簡單，可能只花幾百個 Token；但因為很複雜，費用就增加很多。

cues.en: A few hundred tokens, but because they are very, very complex, this is just one of them, and imagine you have 49 of these, and you need to send all that metadata just to say hi.
cues.zh: 簡單工具只要幾百個 Token，但這裡單一工具就這麼大，再想像有 49 個，全部中繼資料都要送出，只為了說你好。

cues.en: That spends, in this case, 9,449 tokens.
cues.zh: 這個例子花了 9,449 個 Token。

cues.en: And I measure that this tool alone, had we just only added that one tool, that would have been 269 tokens
cues.zh: 我也量過，如果只加入這一個工具，就需要 269 個 Token，

cues.en: just to present to the AI that we have the tools, not even calling them.
cues.zh: 只是告訴 AI 有這個工具，還完全沒有呼叫。

cues.en: So over here, we saw that that was 700 for 40 tools, but here it's one tool, 200.
cues.zh: 前面四十個簡單工具可能約七百個，這裡單一工具就超過兩百。

cues.en: So the complexity of your tools also have an impact on this, as we can see here.
cues.zh: 因此，工具複雜度也會造成影響。

cues.en: So it is not a clear-cut if it's one or the other.
cues.zh: 並沒有明確的一刀切界線。

cues.en: It's more if you have very, very complex tools, you might want to begin to consider switching to skills,
cues.zh: 如果工具非常複雜，就可以開始考慮改用技能，

cues.en: or if you have tons and tons of tools, you might want to consider going to skills instead.
cues.zh: 或是工具數量非常多，也可以考慮技能。

cues.en: But if those two are not the case, and in my opinion, 90%, 99% of all cases, that is not the case.
cues.zh: 但如果這兩個條件都不成立，而在我看來，九成、甚至九十九%的情況都不是如此，

cues.en: And in all those cases, tools makes more sense.
cues.zh: 那麼使用工具就比較合理。

cues.en: So the main summary here is,
cues.zh: 所以最主要的結論是，

cues.en: if in doubt, definitely go buy tools.
cues.zh: 如果不確定，優先使用工具。

cues.en: Definitely go buy tools.
cues.zh: 確實應該先選工具。

cues.en: You will probably save most of the skills or the tokens.
cues.zh: 這樣通常能節省最多 Token。

cues.en: You will have an easier time writing them because they are more concise to write compared to skills.
cues.zh: 撰寫起來也更容易，因為和技能相比，工具定義更精簡。

cues.en: But if you have a lot, or if you have very, very complex skills, might be the way to go.
cues.zh: 但如果數量很多，或工具非常複雜，技能可能更適合。

cues.en: But that is up to the individual case.
cues.zh: 仍然要依個別案例判斷。

cues.en: But now you at least know the parameters of when to make the decision, which you might not have had before.
cues.zh: 不過現在，你至少知道做決定時應該看哪些條件，而不是像之前一樣不清楚。

cues.en: So again, the amount and the complexity of your tools determine if it makes sense to go to skills.
cues.zh: 再次強調，工具的數量與複雜度，決定是否值得改用技能。

cues.en: And in 99% of cases, that is not the case.
cues.zh: 而在九十九%的案例中，並不需要。

cues.en: And that is my main reason for giving that tools are actually in most cases.
cues.zh: 這就是我認為多數情況下，應該使用工具的主要原因。

cues.en: And the default case, probably the way to go instead of going with the new and shiny, unless it's very complex.
cues.zh: 除非需求非常複雜，否則預設應該採用工具，而不是一味追逐最新功能。

cues.en: So that's everything for this one. See you on the next one.
cues.zh: 這次的內容就是這些，下一支影片見。
